skills: Off-field, if no enemy has Cat's Gaze, Bubblegum spends 1 Claw Sharpener to attack for Physical DMG (it uses her initial ATK). Sharpeners (max 6): +2 when anyone opens an Ether Veil, +1 when anyone applies an Anomaly (once per 10s).
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Bounces forward on her inflatable hammer for massive Physical DMG.
Fires Bubblegum from an air gun for Physical DMG; Bubblegum joins the fight.
Hurls Bubblegum for Physical DMG and gives the squad Angelic Chord-ination for 40s. Heavy hit triggers a Quick Assist.

With Angelic Chord-ination (or by holding during Bubblegum Barrage): a joint attack for Physical DMG that opens Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise (squad +50 ATK for 40s). Heavy hit triggers a Quick Assist.
Rides Bubblegum forward for massive Physical DMG; heavy hit triggers a Quick Assist.
Hammer combo then an exploding Bubblegum for massive Physical DMG; +6 Claw Sharpeners. The downward hit triggers a Quick Assist and heals the squad.

core.name: Cuteness Is Justice
core.text:
Angelic Chord-ination gives ATK equal to 30% of her initial ATK, up to {0} (reached at {1} initial ATK).
Bubblegum's attacks, her EX Specials, Chain and Ultimate put Cat's Gaze on enemies for 12s (kept up while she's on-field). When Attack or Anomaly squadmates keep hitting it, it bursts as that Agent's attribute DMG in an area: {2}% of their ATK for Attack Agents, or {3}% for Anomaly Agents with a guaranteed CRIT and +{4}% CRIT DMG. Only the main target's Gaze bursts, and all Gazes clear. Stunned enemies need far fewer hits.

ability.name: Daydreamer's Counterpoint
ability.text: Agents inside Delusion Reprise raise the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier by 30% for 40s. Enters battle with 15 Energy (once per 180s in Investigation Zones).

mindscapes: Enters battle with 15 Energy (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). Cat's Gaze bursts lower DEF by 7% for 40s (max 3, separate timers).
Inside any Ether Veil, the squad gets +10% ATK and she gains 1 Claw Sharpener every 10s. Cat's Gaze needs fewer hits and its burst multiplier rises by 200% (Attack) or 300% (Anomaly).
Ultimate gives the squad +18% DMG for 60s.

EX Special gives Focused Creation! for 8s: she always CRITs, gets CRIT DMG equal to 0.03% of her initial ATK (max 105%), 40% DMG reduction, and can burst Cat's Gaze herself (as an Attack Agent), spending a Claw Sharpener to reapply it. Squad Cat's Gaze bursts deal +50% DMG meanwhile.
